Volume SDF - SideFX
The Volume SDF operation rebuilds a signed distance field from a given isocontour in a volume. The new SDF is the same resolution as the original volume. This can be used to turn a fog volume into an SDF to get fast distance computations. It can also be used to renormalize a signed distance field that has been stretched away from its ideal shape.
